> MODIFYING FROM LAST YEAR TO FOCUS ON NM, OK BORDER AGENCIES

Paring down data for a specific Public Information Request assignment for Spring 2023 Reporting with data.

Unfortunately the original data doesn't have county or any way for me to find agencies close to the New Mexico and Oklahoma borders, so really all I can do is get the agencies together and then manually note them.

It is not ideal, but at least scripted so I can make fixes.

```{r setup, echo=T, results='hide', message=F, warning=F}
library(tidyverse)
library(clipr)
```


## Import

```{r import}
agencies <- read_rds("data-processed/ped_texas_2021.rds")

agencies |> glimpse()
```

## Filter to city and county

```{r pare}
ctycnty <- agencies %>% 
  filter(type %in% c("County", "City")) %>% 
  select(!description)
```


## Find cities

- Name the cities in a list
- modify the data to create a logical column

### Make the list

These are hand-built lists based on a lot of googling, and subject to error. There are cities listed that are NOT in the data, and that should be OK.

### Make it happen

> Needs to be modified

```{r}
agencies_category <- ctycnty %>% 
  mutate(geo_category = case_when(
    type == "City" & agency %in% cities ~ "city_route",
    type == "County" & agency %in% counties ~ "county_route"
  ))

agencies_category %>% 
  count(geo_category)
```

Show the matching cities

```{r}
agencies_category |> 
  filter(geo_category == "city_route")
```

Some error checking

```{r}
agencies_category |> 
  filter(
    str_like(agency, "Dalhart")
  )
```


### Filter to these local agencies

We want to snag these border agencies

```{r local-filter}
border_agencies <- agencies_category %>% 
  filter(!is.na(geo_category)) |> 
  arrange(-total_officers)

border_agencies
```




```{r local-export}
border_agencies %>% write_rds("data-processed/border_agencies_2021.rds")

border_agencies |> write_clip(allow_non_interactive = TRUE)
```
